description_en: Retrieves a list of network resources for a serverless resource group
description_zh: 获取资源组网络资源列表
name: ListNetworks

parameters.description_en: The ID of the resource group.
parameters.help_en: The ID of the resource group
parameters.name: resource_group_id

parameters.description_en: The number of entries per page.
parameters.help_en: The number of entries per page
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.description_en:
The fields used for sorting. Fields such as TriggerTime and StartedTime are supported. The value of this parameter is in the Sort field + Sort by (Desc/Asc) format. By default, results are sorted in ascending order. Valid values:

- Id (Desc/Asc): the network ID

- Status (Desc/Asc): the network status

- CreateUser (Desc/Asc): the user who created the network

- CreateTime (Desc/Asc): the time when the network was created

Default value: CreateTime Asc.
parameters.description_zh:
排序字段列表，支持定时时间、开始时间等字段。格式为"排序字段+排序方式(Desc/Asc)"（Asc可以缺省）。排序字段的枚举值如下：

- Id  (Desc/Asc)：网络ID
- Status (Desc/Asc)：网络状态
- CreateUser (Desc/Asc)：创建用户
- CreateTime (Desc/Asc)：创建时间

默认值为CreateTime Asc
